# MANVIA — Health Records Management API Specification

> Version: 0.1.0-phase0  
> Status: DRAFT — Phase 0 Specification  
> Last Updated: 2026-09-28  

---

## 1. Overview & Security Architecture

The Health Records API manages clinical documents, laboratory panels, imaging reports, and prescriptions.
* **Storage Protocol:** Documents are uploaded and downloaded via short-lived Presigned URLs generated by the S3-compatible `StorageService`.
* **Envelope Encryption:** Each document payload is encrypted using a unique Data Encryption Key (DEK) wrapped by Cloud KMS.
* **Consent Guard:** Doctors may only query or download records if an active `CareRelationship` and valid patient consent grant exist.

---

## 2. Endpoint Specifications

### 2.1 Request Upload Intent (Presigned S3 PUT)
* **HTTP Method:** `POST /api/v1/health-records/upload-intent`
* **Access:** Patient (or Doctor with active write consent)
* **Request Body:**
```json
{
  "category": "LAB_REPORT",
  "documentTitle": "Fasting Lipid & HbA1c Panel",
  "fileName": "blood_work_sep2026.pdf",
  "fileSizeBytes": 1450200,
  "fileMimeType": "application/pdf",
  "sha256Hash": "b94d27b9934d3e08a52e52d7da7dabfac484efe37a5380ee9088f7ace2efcde9",
  "recordedDate": "2026-09-18"
}
```
* **Response `201 Created`:**
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "data": {
    "recordId": "rec_99218471_uuid",
    "uploadUrl": "https://manvia-quarantine-uploads.s3.amazonaws.com/temp/rec_99218471?AWSAccessKeyId=...",
    "expiresInSeconds": 600,
    "requiredHeaders": {
      "Content-Type": "application/pdf"
    }
  }
}
```

---

### 2.2 Finalize Upload (Post-Antivirus & Encryption Ingestion)
* **HTTP Method:** `POST /api/v1/health-records/{recordId}/finalize`
* **Access:** Owner User
* **Response `200 OK`:**
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "data": {
    "recordId": "rec_99218471_uuid",
    "status": "AVAILABLE",
    "documentTitle": "Fasting Lipid & HbA1c Panel",
    "recordedDate": "2026-09-18"
  }
}
```
* Emits domain event: `health_record.uploaded`. Automatically surfaces the record in the unified Health Timeline.

---

### 2.3 List Patient Health Records
* **HTTP Method:** `GET /api/v1/health-records`
* **Access:** Patient (or Doctor with active consent)
* **Query Parameters:**
  * `category`: Filter by category (`LAB_REPORT`, `PRESCRIPTION`, `CLINICAL_SUMMARY`, `IMAGING`)
  * `startDate` & `endDate`: Clinical date range
  * `limit` & `cursor`: Standard pagination
* **Response `200 OK`:**
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "rec_99218471_uuid",
      "category": "LAB_REPORT",
      "documentTitle": "Fasting Lipid & HbA1c Panel",
      "recordedDate": "2026-09-18",
      "fileSizeBytes": 1450200,
      "uploadedBy": "PATIENT",
      "createdAt": "2026-09-18T09:15:00Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

---

### 2.4 Get Presigned Download URL
* **HTTP Method:** `GET /api/v1/health-records/{recordId}/download-url`
* **Access:** Patient (owner) or Doctor (verified with active consent)
* **Response `200 OK`:**
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "data": {
    "downloadUrl": "https://manvia-health-vault.s3.amazonaws.com/vault/rec_99218471?AWSAccessKeyId=...",
    "expiresInSeconds": 300
  }
}
```
* Every download URL issuance writes an immutable record in `audit_logs`.

---

### 2.5 Share Record with Doctor
* **HTTP Method:** `POST /api/v1/health-records/{recordId}/share`
* **Access:** Patient
* **Request Body:**
```json
{
  "doctorId": "DOC-90218471",
  "validUntil": "2026-10-18T00:00:00Z"
}
```
* **Response `200 OK`**
